digest.component_or_area: Library write interface (_lib_writes.py) and derived modules
propositions: _lib_writes.py is at the 800-line hard cap and cannot accept new code without refactoring

The module aggregates seven distinct concerns (genesis, identity/keys, status lifecycle, leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance, signing) that should be separated by concern rather than split mechanically by line count
A three-way split by concern moves mutations and identity/signing to new modules while keeping writes.py as the genesis and status-lifecycle anchor, reducing its size from 800 to ~378 lines
All 27 public names must remain re-exported from _lib_writes to __init__.py and facade surface with no changes to __init__.py or _lib_gates.py, preserving the API and test compatibility
The refactoring is behavior-preserving (bodies relocate byte-identically) and does not alter any import paths or require test file changes
